### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Because the Health Care Act sets no maximum time for a cancer suspicion and Finland lacks uniform diagnostic timetable guidance, the team recommends reporting referral-to-treatment access times using THL Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions (16 cancers) and flagging stalled handovers until the Filha programme's diagnostics recommendation with recommended time limits is carried out before the 2030 mid-term evaluation.

### what_to_do_first.details[2]
